name: Pandora Maze Onna Joushi to Chika Meikyuu ni Tojikomeraretamashita
original_name: パンドラメイズー女上司と地下迷宮に閉じ込められましたー
source: A law enforcement unit directly under the government, commonly known as BRIGHT. Makoto Kurosumi, a carefree member of the unit, is taken by the cool Deputy Captain, Kuina Sahajo, to a mysterious underground facility. It was a den of evil where monstrous creatures roamed. To make matters worse, a cave-in blocked the entrance, trapping the two of them in a labyrinth with no cell service. The only ones they can rely on are each other. A survival mission begins for this polar-opposite pair—a superior and her subordinate—with their lives and escape on the line…
translation: 政府直属执法单位，俗称BRIGHT。无忧无虑的小队成员黑隅诚被帅气的副队长佐哈城古伊娜带到了一个神秘的地下设施。那是一个邪恶的巢穴，怪物们在此出没。更糟糕的是，一个塌方堵住了入口，将他们两人困在一个没有手机服务的迷宫里。他们唯一可以依靠的就是彼此。这对截然相反的搭档——上级和下级——面临着生死存亡的生存任务……
